title: Responsive rendering across viewports
description: Verify the page renders correctly and remains accessible across 3 device viewports: mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1280x800). The page should load and display primary content on all screen sizes.
test_case_text: Test responsive design: Load the page and capture screenshots on three viewports: mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1280x800). Verify the page loads and the URL is correct on each viewport. The page should render without critical errors on all screen sizes.
